Silent as a Falling Leaf

Quest Type

Exploration

Chapter

Averardo Vault: Act I

Description

Tension simmers between the Montelli family and the Order of the Deep. Both Carlotta and the Order have simultaneously extended invitations, requesting your presence,to witness their supposed amicable relations. You are tasked with venturing into the heart of Montelli wealth, the richest place in all of Ragunna: the Averardo Vault. Whispers abound of secrets hidden within the vault's depths, but is there any truth to these rumors?

Silent as a Falling Leaf is a Exploration Quest that occurs in Rinascita, Vault Underground, [[{{{nation}}}]].

Summary[]

You receive a letter from Carlotta inviting you to Averardo Vault as an intermediary for an escort mission.
After accepting the request, Zani gives you special security clearance prepared by the Montelli family upon your arrival at the vault.
You and Zani head off to meet the representative from the Order. To Zani's surprise, it is Phoebe, the Acolyte who joined your adventure before.
Upon your arrival at the Precious Metals and Artworks Depository, the vault's security mode activates, locking you in the area. You decide to head to the security room.
After finally arriving at the security room, Zani informs you that to leave the vault you must use your clearance to acces its deepest area.
She suggests you utilize the vault's cameras to avoid any possible defense systems.
After reviewing all the surveillance footage, you discover that a person named "Ash" might have taken the vault's security module. You'll need to find Ash to leave.
Zani mentions rumors about a "secret cache" inside the Averardo Vault and suspects it's what the thief is after.
You encounter a vault employee who claims to be Lily, but she can't remember why she is there. Although you find Lily's identity suspicious, for her own safety, you invite her to accompany you.
You find a note left by Ash for his family, mentioning a treasure deep within the Averardo Vault. You make the assumption that this is where the imposter obtained clues about the "secret cache."
You must get to "Ash" before he can trigger more defense systems.
Seeing there's no end to this chase, you decide to use the vault's defense systems to guide "Ash" towards the Echo train terminus and intercept him there.
You manage to find "Ash," but he jumps onto a train before you can grab him. Still, everything is going as planned. The train runs on a single rail, and the final stop is where you will catch him.
The Echo train experienced an accident and fell, but fortunately, no one was injured. While the train Echo seems to have sustained only a minor scratch, it is now unable to move...
You unexpectedly arrive at an unmarked area on the map. Here, Lily seems to recall some memories.
You defeat the Echo guards and corner "Ash." Lily now remembers everything: She, along with many researchers and artists, had been imprisoned by the Order and were deprived of their rights to research and create.
The Montelli family built a sanctuary deep within the vault to protect them. They lived their final moments here.
Lily's soul can finally rest in peace. Before leaving, she urges "Ash" to check the vault's secret cache.
Ash learns about his grandfather's fate and the truth about the vault's secret cache. He will now bear the consequences of his actions.
The path has been opened. It's time to leave.
You discover that the "secret cache" is actually a tree, and the item the Order requested the Montelli family to transport was a bomb that would react to the Reverberations in the vault.

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing the "Wait at the back entrance of Averardo Vault" step awards Montelli Clearance Module - Level I.
  • Completing the "Leave the deepest part of the vault" step will permanently change the Averardo Vault map, opening the Vault's "wings".
  • Completing the quest awards the Exploration: Rinascita trophy This Moment Is Yours to Cherish.

Dialogue[]

A letter from Carlotta
SenderCarlotta
Date
Dear (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍),

It's been a while. I hope you've been enjoying your time in Rinascita.

I'm writing to ask you a favor. The Order seems to be planning to store something in the family's vault, likely as part of some larger scheme. With your connections to both sides, you're the only one I can trust to handle this discreetly.

I'll send someone to guide you, of course. The task is simple: deliver the object to the vault. I've prepared a reward that will make it worth your time.

If you're willing to assist, please visit Averardo Vault for more details.

Yours,
Carlotta
AttachmentsNone
An Invitation from the Order of the Deep
SenderOrder of the Deep
Date
Please forgive the formality of reaching out in writing, but given the sensitivity of the matter, we believe it is the most appropriate method.

Thanks to your effort, the turbulence in Ragunna has begun to settle. As you may be aware, the Order has had its share of misunderstandings with the Montellis. The current peace is a credit to your invaluable contributions.

We hold firmly to the vision of a united and harmonious Rinascita under the blessings of Imperator. To that end, we have decided to entrut one of our most cherished relics to the Montelli family's vault for safekeeping. This marks the first time an Order item will be housed in Averardo Vault.

After cordial discussions with the family's representatives, both sides have agreed to appoint delegates to oversee the transportation of this item. To ensure the process goes smoothly, we also wish for a neutral and trusted mediator to accompany them.

Naturally, you are the only choice we can entrust with such a role.

At your earliest convenience, please meet us at the entrance of Averardo Vault, where our delegate and the family's representative will await your arrival.

May the grave of Imperator guide you.

Sincerely,
Order of the Deep
AttachmentsNone
Quest Description
Accept Carlotta's job to mediate the "Friendly Collaboration" between The Order and the Montelli family.
(Head to the back entrance of Averardo Vault)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Am I early? Where's that person Carlotta sent...
Confused Vault Staff: We can clock out now? I didn't know Treasurer Pacino had taken up charity work!
Lazy Vault Staff: Yeah whatever, it's a paid day off. I could do with a nap anyway...
Zani: Ah, there you are. It's been a while since we last worked together.
Zani: I was not expecting you to take this job.
Carlotta said it's paid.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Carlotta promised a generous reward once it's done.
Zani: Ah, well worth the trip then.
I expect a favor in return.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): An opportunity like this doesn't come round often.
Zani: The family's favor is more precious than money. Remember to use it on something worthwhile.
Zani: Now about the job—Lady Carlotta must have briefed you in her letter. I'm curious what the Order is thinking stashing their relic in the Montelli vault.
Zani: At any rate, my job here is to keep you safe. Take this pass, it's the only one that allows visitors access to the vault's interior.
Zani: Time to go. The Order's rep is waiting for us.
Quest Description
Enter the Averardo Vault and escort the collection to the depository.
Broadcast: Attention all staff. Please cease work at once and leave the vault. We wish you a pleasant day.
(Idle)
Vault Staff: Why are we getting a day off all of a sudden? What about the meeting today?
(Idle)
Vault Staff: Woohoo! A day off! I heard Margherita's just put out something new on their menu. Perfect timing!
Vault Staff: Great idea. And since we're getting off this early, there won't be a line, right?
(Idle)
Vault Staff: So... we don't have to work anymore?
(Head to the designated location)
Broadcast: Attention all staff. Please cease work at once and leave the vault. We wish you a pleasant day.
Zani: Don't worry, it's already been approved by the higher-ups. They see this as a valuable opportunity to work with the Order and as such requested your assistance.
(Idle)
Vault Staff: Right, I do have some time off now, but there won't be an extension for the deadline, which means I'll have to take the rest of my work home. So...
(Head to the designated location)
Phoebe: Mmhmm, I see. You've done a great job—
Phoebe: Oh, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍) and Ms. Zani! Nice to see you again!
Hi there, Phoebe.
Hello again, Acolyte.
Zani: It's been a while. Mind if I ask what you were doing just now?
Phoebe: Oh, we're just chatting. They seemed lonely. Not many people talk to them.
Zani: This train Echo? It's been running since the vault was built. It chugs along, doing its thing in silence.
Zani: But I do believe your company has made its day.
Zani: But if I remember correctly, you are not the representative the Order informed me of.
Phoebe: Yes, it was supposed to be another Acolyte. But she's busy with the Order's work, so I volunteered.
Zani: Huh. Did the thought of working with the Montellis scare her away?
Phoebe: Perhaps, Ms. Zani, but I'm sure she'd think differently if she met a Montelli employee like you.
Phoebe: Seeing as the Montelli family and the Order are both blessed by the Sentinel, our paths were bound to cross eventually.
Zani: ...I'm glad you see it that way. Now, do you have it?
Phoebe: Certainly, as you requested, the escorts carried an empty case while the relic stayed with me.
Zani: Thank you.
What's inside?
What exactly is this thing?
Phoebe: It's an important relic entrusted to the Montellis. That's all I know.
Zani: Same here, but it doesn't matter. Lady Carlotta gave me this job. I just follow orders, no questions asked. That's how you work for the Montellis.
Zani: Our top priority is to get the job done, nice and clean.
Zani: By the way, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), the device from Lady Carlotta should have top security clearance, so you'll be able to operate the train Echo. I hope you enjoy driving.
(While on train)
Zani: There are several tracks reserved especially for us. Just switch over when you see the sign.
(While on train)
Phoebe: I'm amazed it's so steady on tracks this steep!
Zani: Perhaps your earlier encouragement did wonders, miss.
(Head to the designated location)
Phoebe: What are they, Ms. Zani?
Zani: Not sure, but we'd better take them down.
(Defeat the guard)
What's this?
Zani, what happened?
I smell trouble.
Zani: The vault's security mode has been activated. Someone touched something they shouldn't have.
Thieves?
Zani: Unlikely. All personnel were sent home at the start of this assignment. The highest security protocols are in place too.
Phoebe: Should we ask for outside help?
Zani: We can't, not while the vault's security Echo is there. It's capable of sensing danger.
Zani: Once it detects a threat, it locks down the vault, jams all signals, and activates a bunch of troublesome Echo guards.
Zani: Ha, a triple whammy.
Phoebe: That means there's no way out and no hope for backup...
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Any backdoors? The Montellis must have designed one.
Zani: There is, but it's a bit tricky. Anyway, we need to access the security room first. Your clearance might come in handy.
Zani: Don't worry. Keeping you safe is part of my job.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Alright, let's go.
Zani: Keep an eye on the surveillance cameras—they're all interlinked. Guards will be summoned if you're detected by one for too long.
Zani: With top clearance, you should be able to disable some of the cameras. Give it a try.
(Idle)
Echo Greeter: Initiating self-diagnosis... Self-diagnosis canceled by default...
(Talk to Echo Greeter)
Echo Greeter: Greetings. The Averardo Vault is in lockdown. Please proceed to the train Echo station and take Line 1 to evacuate the vault.
We need to go to the evacuation site. When will the train depart?
Echo Greeter: Understood. Current train Echo passengers: 0. You may depart at a time of your choosing.
Perfect. Do we need anything to board the train?
Echo Greeter: To depart on Line 1, please present your employee ID, or temporary ID, and a valid emergency pass issued by the security room.
(Present the clearance device.)
Echo Greeter: Verifying now. Please wait.
Echo Greeter: Please present your emergency pass to board the Averardo Vault's train Echo. Running on a specially designed track, the train Echo ensures an evacuation that is both efficient and convenient. We wish you a pleasant evacuation.
How can we get this emergency pass?
Echo Greeter: Please demonstrate lawful vault entry by presenting an emergency pass issued from the security room located in the next depository. It may be accessed by the train Echo.
Echo Greeter: Once you obtain an emergency pass, you will be authorized to board. Running on a specially designed track, the train Echo ensures an evacuation that is both efficient and convenient. We wish you a pleasant evacuation.
Hold on...
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Are you seriously telling me that I have to go deeper into the vault to get out of here?
Echo Greeter: Processing... Please present your emergency pass to board the train Echo of the Averardo Vault...
I've had enough!
...It seems I won't be taking the train.
I ought to take you to the scrap yard.
We won't be taking the train for now.
We won't be taking the train for now.
We won't be taking the train for now.
We won't be taking the train for now.
We won't be taking the train for now.
Zani: Security lockdown... That's odd. The Employee Manual says this mode can only be activated by...
Zani: Um, miss. If I may, what are you doing?
Phoebe: Me? Oh, this Echo seems to have a headache. I'm trying to help.
Zani: Wait, even if it is malfunctioning, you shouldn't hit it with your—
Beep... Bleep...
Echo Greeter: Depository One security module malfunction. Lockdown detected. Emergency pass override activated. Line 1 temporary access granted. Please evacuate via the nearest exit.
Zani: What the?!
Phoebe: Is something wrong, Ms. Zani?
Zani: No... never mind.
Zani: Active security mode means all the main routes inside the vault are sealed. But with your device, we should be able to override their protocols.
(Head to the designated area)
Phoebe: This vault... feels suffocating.
Zani: I find it comforting. There's no idle chit-chat here—just work, plain and simple.
(Head to the designated area)
Phoebe: Watch out! It's starting to move!
(Head to the designated area)
Zani: The security control room in this depository is right ahead. You can put your device to good use there.
Zani: Each depository has its own security room. Just verify your device here to obtain security clearance. It's only valid for this depository, though.
Sounds complicated.
Zani: Necessary for the vault's security, but yes, it's a hassle.
Zani: We're stuck here for now, and the only way out is to get clearance from each of the depositories. That means going deeper into the vault.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): How much deeper?
Zani: Beats me. The security room only controls the depository it's in and grants access to the next.
Phoebe: So, aside from a handful of senior members of the Montelli family, no one knows the full layout of this vault?
Zani: I don't know. Maybe a handful of people who've worked here for over thirty years might.
Zani: Let's get clearance first. It might help us avoid most of the defense systems triggered by the lockdown.
(Check the surveillance footage)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Do the Montellis have a love for building labyrinths?
Zani: Not really. It's all for the security of the vault.
Phoebe: Maybe we can make a detour from this side...
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Wait... something's off with this thing. Has it been tampered with?
Zani: Let me see... Tsk, someone removed the hidden security module.
Zani: Check the log file with your clearance... There it is, it was taken by "Ash." The name rings a bell...
Zani: Yes, the Employee Manual mentions an old employee named Ash who designed most of the vault's security features. But he passed away.
Zani: It seems this "Ash" also had access to the control room. Could it be... that old woman?
Zani: This is only speculation, but what if this "Ash" stole from the vault and took the security module? That would explain why a complete lockdown was triggered.
Phoebe: What's a hidden security module? Is it like a key?
Zani: Pretty much. It's the monitoring core that powers this entire depository. If we don't get it back, we'll be stuck here for good.
Zani: A vault employee could easily access the module, but nobody would dare steal it. Everyone knows that'll trigger a lockdown of the entire vault.
Phoebe: But what if that's exactly what they want?
Phoebe: Think about it. There's no one in the vault except for us, and all comms are blocked. It's the perfect opportunity for a thief.
Zani: Don't tell me they're searching for... Never mind, we need to catch this rat before they cause us more trouble.
Zani: Let's go find out.
(Head to the designated location)
Zani: These Echo guards are controlled by the security system. You can also command them with your clearance.
Zani: The higher your clearance is, the more obedient they become.
(Head to the designated location)
Phoebe: Watch out! It's fast!
(Head to the designated location)
Phoebe: Nice moves! Don't worry about me. I'll keep up.
(Head to the designated location)
Zani: Ha... what a pain in the neck...
(Optional - Investigate the covered vase)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): There's a covered vase here. What's the story behind this one?
Zani: Beautiful or ugly, what do you say?
Beautiful.
Zani: The Montellis think so, which is why they don't want to share it.
Ugly.
Zani: The Montellis disagree, but they keep it hidden for people of your taste.
(Open the Advanced Supply Chest)
Zani: Take them. They're the "personal bonus" Lady Carlotta arranged just for you.
(Optional - Investigate the empty cabinet)
Zani: Interesting. It's labeled as a donation from the Order, but the cabinet is empty.
Zani: "The air collected before the Lament."
Zani: Ha, it might have some research value if it's real.
(Optional - Investigate the scroll)
Phoebe: "A mysterious scroll painting that leads to a secluded retreat."
Phoebe: I heard a tiger ironsmith wielding a greatsword lives inside this scroll.
(Check the missing collection)
Log File: Latest log: Ash
Zani: So, it seems this "Ash," whoever they are, messed around with the display cases, took the module, and triggered the lockdown that trapped us here.
Phoebe: Does each display case have its own log?
Zani: Ah, you know how it is. Some thieves have made "sneaking into the vault" their sole purpose in life.
Zani: Let's hope this Ash isn't after the "secret cache."
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): What's that?
Phoebe: Ah, I've heard rumors that the Montelli vault holds the most valuable treasure in all of Ragunna.
Zani: I doubt it. Not even the most senior Montelli employee knows anything about this so-called treasure.
Zani: But that ridiculous tale still draws in idiots trying to break in—hundreds of them every year.
Zani: They think a stolen ID will let them waltz into the vault, but as I said, each depository has its own security module. When the vault is in lockdown, it's impregnable.
Zani: Not even a single Shell Credit can be taken, let alone any of the vault's artifacts and collections.
Amazing, but we've got work to do.
Phoebe: Let's head up to the monitoring room on the top level and check if the old lady we saw in the surveillance footage is "Ash."
Zani: Some of the defense systems have been activated. We should tread carefully from here on out.
(Optional - Investigate the painting)
Phoebe: How beautiful... but why was it covered?
Zani: Really? You don't know this painting?
Phoebe: Isn't it just a landscape?
Zani: Be my witness, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)—what I'm about to say is purely to satisfy our Acolyte's curiosity. No hidden agenda.
Why the sudden suspense?
Alright.
What's so special about this painting?
Zani: This piece, titled "Ballad Beneath the Stars," may appear simple at first—just a shepherd tending his flock under a vast sky. However, the pattern on the shepherd's clothes resembles the Order's emblem, only flipped upside down, and the number of stars matches the recorded blessings bestowed by our Sentinel Imperator.
Zani: What's more, the number of sheep is the same as the Sentinel's wings. Given that some fanatics claim the Sentinel's divine messages are fabrications, when you connect the dots, doesn't it seem like this shepherd is hinting at something?
Phoebe: Uh... What?
Phoebe: According my [sic] interpretation of the Codex, I don't see how this painting implies anything untoward.
Zani: Maybe not to you or some of your fellow Acolytes, and certainly not to the Montellis or the painter. But there are others who don't share that view and their voices are often the loudest.
Zani: That's why this painting is covered—to avoid stirring up trouble.
Phoebe: Very prudent, but it's still a shame people can't admire its beauty anymore.
Zani: What about the risk of people slandering the Order? Doesn't that bother you?
Phoebe: Just like some will appreciate a piece of art, others will hate or misinterpret it. The same goes for the Order.
Phoebe: People's views are shaped by their backgrounds and experiences. What's precious to one might be another's poison.
Phoebe: Everyone is entitled to their opinion. As long as they genuinely believe it, I don't see a problem.
Phoebe: Locking this painting away is perhaps the best option for now, but I believe it will eventually return to where it belongs, for everyone to see.
Zani: If more people thought like you, we'd see a lot less trouble in the world.
(Head to the designated area)
??: ...Hello.
Phoebe: Excuse me, ma'am, do you work here?
??: Sorry, if this sounds odd, but... I'm a bit confused. I don't remember why I'm here.
Lily: All I know is that I do work in the vault, and my name is... Lily.
Lily: But this isn't the section I oversee. Why am I here... Why are you here?
Zani: Lady Carlotta has tasked us with a special delivery. May I see your ID, Ms. Lily?
Lily: I only have this card.
Zani: Thank you. Hmm... Confidential Researcher? The vault does have that position, but a researcher shouldn't be in this section.
Zani: The ID is real—the anti-counterfeit features check out.
Phoebe: She doesn't look like she could be a thief's accomplice, either.
Zani: That thing you're carrying seems to disagree.
Phoebe: The Order's relics are kept a secret from everyone, including an Acolyte like myself. I can't say what it's reacting to.
Phoebe: But... I do have a strange feeling about Ms. Lily.
We shouldn't leave her here.
We should bring her with us.
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): She could accidentally trigger something dangerous if left alone. That's the last thing we need.
Zani: Agreed. And if she is somehow involved, we'd save a lot of effort by taking her with us.
Zani: I'm sorry, ma'am, but you'll need to come with us.
Lily: ...
Phoebe: I understand your hesitation, but with the vault sealed, you'll be safer with us.
Lily: Alright, I'll come with you.
Zani: Good. Time to use your clearance, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Let's find out what's really going on in this vault.
(Upgrade Clearance)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): More guards are gathering.
Zani: The longer the vault stays in lockdown, the more defense systems and Echo guards get activated.
Phoebe: Someone's hiding over there!
Zani: Ma'am, does the name "Ash" mean anything to you?
Lily: Old Ash? He used to say he wanted to sleep among the Echoes to study their behaviors. What a stubborn man.
Zani: So the real Ash did exist. As for that man hiding over there... he might have stolen Ash's ID and gotten stuck here.
Lily: Ash's ID was stolen? Outsiders couldn't have done that—we've been in here for at least twenty years. Even with my fuzzy memory, I know that much.
Twenty years?!
Is this a vault or a prison?
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Twenty years in this vault... Sounds like a living hell...
Zani: If it were me, I could maybe last... Well, ten years tops.
Phoebe: But... no one should be working in such awful conditions, Ms. Zani.
Zani: Yeah, well, personally I just hope to live long enough to make the most out of my retirement someday. Anyway, we've got an imposter on our hands posing as "Ash."
Zani: Let's take the train to the Echo depository. We must find this thief and retrieve the security module. After that, we can decide what to do next.
(Head to the designated location)
Zani: You actually fixed it. What a genius move, miss.
Phoebe: Oh, that's nothing. If they relapses, I'll be back to perform more percussive maintenance.
(While on train)
Zani: Stay alert, everyone. During training, I was told to avoid the Echo Depository unless absolutely necessary.
Zani: Each Echo is unique, and trust me, you don't want to know what happens if one gets damaged.
Phoebe: Be careful, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! Something's coming our way!
Zani: It's a special Echo guard. Tsk, I didn't expect it to follow us this far. We gotta lose it!
Phoebe: Don't worry about us, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! Just focus on operating the train Echo!
Zani: Hold tight! It's just the safety mode kicking in!
Phoebe: Are you alright, Ms. Lily?
Lily: I'm fine. Be careful.
Zani: Ha... I didn't expect this fella in the vault.
Phoebe: Thank goodness, everyone's safe.
(Defeat the rampaging Echoes)
Phoebe: That was close! Are you alright, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
(Investigate)
Zani: Tsk, the imposter just ran away.
Phoebe: There's a book. What is this...
A Letter Written on Torn Paper
My dear boy,

Leaving you is the last thing I want, but these troubled times force my hand. All I can offer now are a few words on this torn paper.

Stand tall and live your life with pride. Your parents gave their lives for the dignity of art, and you carry the same blood in your veins.

I've sacrificed my freedom in pursuit of the endless mysteries these Echoes hold, but I believe in you—you have a strong heart. Hold on to hope and keep moving forward.

One day, the treasure we have valued deep within the Averardo Vault will bring forth new hope.

With Love,
Ash
